title: Polls close in Russian wartime election with ruling party set to dominate
english: Voting has concluded in Russia's first parliamentary elections since the full-scale invasion of Ukraine, with President Putin's ruling party expected to retain control. While the Kremlin intended the election to demonstrate public backing for the war, the process was marked by significant drone attacks from Ukraine and widespread international condemnation for holding votes in occupied regions. Authorities reported a turnout of roughly 57 percent, though officials in Kyiv and the European Union have declared the election in annexed territories illegal.
amharic: ሩሲያ ዩክሬንን ከወረረች በኋላ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ያካሄደችው የፓርላማ ምርጫ ተጠናቋል፣ በፕሬዝዳንት ፑቲን የሚመራው ገዢ ፓርቲም እንደሚያሸንፍ ይጠበቃል። ክሬምሊን ምርጫውን ለጦርነቱ ያለውን የህዝብ ድጋፍ ማሳያ ለማድረግ ቢሞክርም፣ በምርጫው ወቅት በዩክሬን በኩል መጠነ ሰፊ የድሮን ጥቃቶች ተፈጽመዋል። በአውሮፓ ህብረት እና በኪዬቭ አስተዳደር ምርጫው በተያዙ የዩክሬን ግዛቶች መካሄዱ ህገ-ወጥ እንደሆነ ተገልጿል።

Mootummaan Ruusiyaas filannoo kana deeggarsa waraanaaf qaban agarsiisuuf kan fayyadame ta'us, yeroo filannoo kanaatti haleellaa xiyyaaraa Yukreen irraa dhufeen jeequmsi uumameera. title: France to summon Iran envoy after language centre closure in Tehran
english: France is planning to summon the Iranian ambassador in Paris following the sudden closure of a French-language school in Tehran. Iranian officials claim the center was involved in illegal activities and networking with the country's elite, while France insists the move is unjustified. This incident follows recent tensions between the two nations, including previous disputes regarding French embassy staff.

Aangeyyoonni Iraan, mana barumsichaa kun hojii seeraan alaa fi qondaaltota biyyattii waliin walqunnamtii dhoksaa uumaa akka ture himatu; Faransaayiin garuu tarkaanfichi kan hin fudhatamnee fi haqa kan hin qabne dha jetteetti. Walitti buutiin kun hariiroo biyyoota lamaanii gidduutti jiru kan caalaatti jabeessu ta'ee mul'ata.

title: Blasts rock town in Syria's Aleppo
english: Several strong explosions occurred in the Syrian town of al-Eis, located within the Aleppo region, early on Monday morning. State media confirmed the incident, though no specific details regarding the origin of the blasts have been released. Authorities are currently working to determine what triggered the explosions.
amharic: ሰኞ ዕለት በሶሪያ አሌፖ ግዛት በሚገኘው አል-ኢስ ከተማ ውስጥ ከፍተኛ ፍንዳታዎች ተከስተዋል። የመንግስት ሚዲያዎች የፍንዳታውን መከሰት ያረጋገጡ ቢሆንም፣ የደረሱበትን ምክንያት እስካሁን ማወቅ አልተቻለም። ባለስልጣናት በጉዳዩ ላይ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Dilbata gara Wiixataatti ganama garaa barii magaalaa al-Eis kanneen jedhamtu, kan Soriyaa kutaa Aleppo keessatti argamtu keessatti dhoohaan guddaan tokko mudateera. Miidiyaan mootummaa dhimma kana mirkaneesseus, sababa dhoohichaa ilaalchisee hanga ammaa ibsi ifa ta'e hin laatame. Qaamoleen mootummaa dhimma kana ilaalchisee qorannoo geggeessaa jiru.

title: ‘I'm so, so sorry’: Ed Sheeran addresses Gaza on stage after losing every opening act
english: Ed Sheeran publicly apologized after removing rapper Macklemore from his tour following pressure from stadium owner Robert Kraft regarding Macklemore's pro-Palestine views. During his performance in Philadelphia, Sheeran expressed regret for his difficult decisions and labeled the ongoing war in Gaza as unjustifiable and catastrophic. The concert schedule was significantly delayed because Sheeran had to perform alone after all his opening acts were withdrawn.
amharic: ኤድ ሺራን ራፐር ማክለሞርን ከኮንሰርቱ የሰረዘው ስታዲየሙ ባለቤት በነበረው ጫና ምክንያት መሆኑን ተከትሎ ይቅርታ ጠይቋል። በፊላደልፊያ ባደረገው ትርኢት ወቅት፣ በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ያለውን ጦርነት ተቀባይነት የሌለው እና አሰቃቂ ሲል ገልጾ፣ በወሰዳቸው ውሳኔዎች መጸጸቱን ተናግሯል። ሌሎች የሙዚቃ አቅራቢዎች በመሰረዛቸው ምክንያት የኮንሰርቱ ሰዓት ተራዝሞ ዘፋኙ ብቻውን ለመዘፈን ተገዷል።
oromo: Ed Sheeran raapera Macklemore jedhamu qophii isaa keessaa erga baasee booda dhiifama gaafateera; kunis kan ta'e abbaan istaadiyamichaa Robert Kraft, yaada Macklemore kan Falasxiin deggaru irratti dhiibbaa waan uumeefi. Sheeran qophii Filadeelfiyaa irratti, waraanni Gazaarra jiru fudhatama kan hin qabneefi balaa hamaa kan geessise ta'uu ibsuun, murtoo isaatti gaabbuu isaa ibseera. Qophiiwwan baneen hundi waan haqamaniif, Sheeran kophaasaa hojjachuun isaa qophiin kun yeroo dheeraaf akka ture taasiseera.

title: Israeli forces wound Palestinian woman and two children in Gaza
english: Israeli military operations across Gaza have resulted in injuries to a woman and two children. According to local reports, the victims were hurt in separate incidents involving gunfire and a drone strike. Additionally, naval forces targeted fishermen working off the coast of central Gaza.
amharic: በጋዛ በተፈጸሙ የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ጥቃቶች አንዲት ሴትና ሁለት ህፃናት ላይ ጉዳት ደርሷል። በአካባቢው ምንጮች መረጃ መሰረት፣ ተጎጂዎቹ በጥይት እና በድሮን ጥቃት የተጎዱ ሲሆን በተጨማሪም የባህር ኃይል ሃይሎች በመካከለኛው ጋዛ የባህር ዳርቻ ላይ የነበሩ አሳ አጥማጆች ላይ ተኩስ ከፍተዋል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el iddoo gara garaa Gaazaatti bananiin dubartii tokko fi ijoollee lama miidhaan irra ga'eera. Gabaasni naannichaa akka ibsutti, miidhaan kun kan ga'e dhukaasaa fi haleellaa xiyyaara nama maleen (drone) yoo ta'u, gama biraatiin immoo qarqara galaana Gaazaa giddu galeessatti qabattoo (fish) qabattota irratti haleellaan banameera.

title: Houthis declare 'blockade for blockade' on Saudi, assure US ships are safe
english: The Houthi movement has announced a strategy of 'blockade for blockade' against Saudi Arabia, vowing to challenge Saudi restrictions by targeting their ships in the Red Sea. Despite this aggression, the group has assured the United States that American vessels remain safe and will not be attacked. Their primary goal remains ending the Saudi-led campaign to restore Yemeni infrastructure and secure national economic resources.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በሳውዲ አረቢያ ላይ የሚጥሉትን እገዳ ለመበቀል በባህር ላይ እርምጃ እንደሚወስዱ አስታውቀዋል። ቡድኑ የሳውዲ መርከቦችን ኢላማ እንደሚያደርግ ቢገልጽም፣ የአሜሪካ መርከቦች ግን ደህንነታቸው የተጠበቀ እንደሆነ ማረጋገጫ ሰጥተዋል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው በየመን ላይ የሚደረገውን ዘመቻ ለማስቆም እና የሀገሪቱን ወደቦችና የኢኮኖሚ ሀብቶች ለመመለስ ታስቦ ነው።
oromo: Houthiinis Saudii Arabiyaa irratti ukkammii isaanii deebisuuf jechuun markaboota isaanii galaana diimaa irratti akka miidhan akeekkachiisaniiru. Gareen kun Saudi Arabiyaa qofa kan xiyyeeffatu yoo ta'u, markaboonni Ameerikaa garuu nagaa akka ta'an mirkaneessaniiru. Kaayyoon isaanii inni guddaan duula Saudiin Yemen irratti gaggeessitu dhaabsisuufi qabeenya biyyattii deebifachuudha.

title: Trump administration prepares to sanction ICC, WSJ reports
english: President Donald Trump is moving to penalize the International Criminal Court following its decision to issue arrest warrants for senior Israeli officials. According to reports, the administration will soon restrict financial transactions with the court after a short transition period. These sanctions were ordered shortly after Trump took office to retaliate against the court's war crimes investigation involving Gaza.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከፍተኛ የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት ላይ የአለም አቀፍ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት የእስር ትእዛዝ ማውጣቱን ተከትሎ ማዕቀብ ለመጣል እየተዘጋጁ ነው። ዘገባዎች እንደሚያሳዩት መንግስታቸው የፍርድ ቤቱን የገንዘብ ልውውጦች ለመገደብ ውሳኔ አሳልፏል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው በፍልስጤም ጋዛ ላይ የተፈጸሙ ጦርነቶችን በሚመለከት ፍርድ ቤቱ እያካሄደ ያለውን ምርመራ ለመቃወም ነው።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Doolaard Traamp hoogganoota Israa'eel irratti ajaja hidhaa waan baaseef, Manni Murtii Yakkaa Addunyaa (ICC) irratti tarkaanfii adabbii fudhachuuf qophaa'aa jiru. Gabaasni akka ibsutti, mootummaan isaa guyyoota muraasa booda walta'iinsa maallaqaa mana murtiichaa wajjin jiru akka dhorguuf murteesseera. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame, mana murtichi yakka waraanaa Gaazaarratti raawwatame jedhu qorachuu isaa mormuufidha.

title: Man, 82, dies after beach fight with 76-year-old over sunlounger in Greece
english: An 82-year-old man died after a violent dispute over a sunlounger at a beach near Athens, Greece. The altercation involved a 76-year-old man who has since been arrested by local authorities. Emergency responders attempted to save the victim with CPR, but he unfortunately passed away after being transported to the hospital.
amharic: ግሪክ አቴንስ አቅራቢያ በሚገኝ የባህር ዳርቻ ላይ በፀሐይ መታጠቢያ ወንበር ምክንያት በተፈጠረ ግጭት የ82 ዓመት አዛውንት ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ግጭቱ የተፈጠረው ከ76 ዓመት አዛውንት ጋር ሲሆን፣ ግለሰቡ በአሁኑ ወቅት በፖሊስ ቁጥጥር ስር ውሏል። የድንገተኛ ህክምና ባለሙያዎች የአዛውንቱን ህይወት ለማትረፍ ጥረት ቢያደርጉም ወደ ሆስፒታል ካመሩ በኋላ ህይወታቸው ማለፉ ተረጋግጧል።
oromo: Giriikitti bakka bishaan daakuu tokkotti, namni umuriin isaa 82 ta'e tokko garaagarummaa teessoo aduutti fayyadamuu irratti uumameen du'eera. Walitti bu'iinsi kun nama umuriin isaa 76 ta'e waliin kan uumame yoo ta'u, namichi kunis poolisiin qabameera. Ogeeyyonni fayyaa lubbuu namichaa oolchuuf carraaqqii godhanis, gara hospitaalaatti erga geessamee booda lubbuun isaa darbeera.

title: Qatar PM urges Gulf security framework with Iran
english: Qatar's Prime Minister, Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani, is calling for a formal security agreement between Gulf nations and Iran. He stated that regional stability depends on creating a framework where countries no longer view one another as threats. This proposal aims to move beyond current tensions to foster better diplomatic relations throughout the region.
amharic: የቀጣሩ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሼክ መሐመድ ቢን አብዱልረህማን አል ታኒ በባህረ ሰላጤው አገራት እና በኢራን መካከል የጸጥታ ስምምነት እንዲኖር ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። የቀጣናው መረጋጋት የሚመጣው አገራት እርስ በርስ ስጋት እንደማይፈጥሩ የሚያረጋግጥ ማዕቀፍ ሲኖር ብቻ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። ይህ ሃሳብ አሁን ካለው ውጥረት በመውጣት በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ የተሻለ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት ለመፍጠር ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Ministirri Muummee Qatar, Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani, biyyoota Gulf fi Iran gidduutti waligaltee nageenyaa akka uumamuu qabu gaafataniiru. Nagaan naannichaa kan mirkanaa'uu danda'u, biyyoonni walii walii isaanii sodaachisaa akka hin taane kan mirkaneessu sirni yoo uumame qofa akka ta'e ibsaniiru. Dhiheenyi kun walitti bu'iinsa ammaa furuun hariiroo dippilomaasii naannicha keessatti fooyyessuuf kan gargaaruudha.

title: Argentina’s Left stages ‘March of Anger’ over Milei’s austerity measures
english: Thousands of demonstrators gathered in Buenos Aires for a 'March of Anger' to protest against the severe economic austerity measures introduced by Argentina's government. Left-wing groups led the demonstration, arguing that the recent budget cuts are significantly harming working-class families. The participants expressed their strong opposition to the administration's current financial policies through these widespread public rallies.
amharic: በአርጀንቲና የዋጋ ቅነሳ እርምጃዎችን በመቃወም በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰልፈኞች በቦነስ አይረስ የቁጣ ሰልፍ አድርገዋል። በግራ ዘመም ቡድኖች የተመራው ይህ ሰልፍ የመንግስት የኢኮኖሚ ማሻሻያዎች በሰራተኛ ቤተሰቦች ላይ ከፍተኛ ጫና እያሳደሩ መሆኑን ለመግለጽ የታለመ ነው። ተቃዋሚዎቹ በመንግስት እየተወሰዱ ያሉ የቁጠባ እርምጃዎች የኑሮ ሁኔታን እየጎዱ መሆኑን በመጥቀስ ቅሬታቸውን አሰምተዋል።
oromo: Arjantiinaa keessatti hiriirtonni kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman mootummaan tarkaanfii dinagdee cimaa fudhate mormuun magaalaa Buwonos Ayiresitti 'Hiriira Aarii' gaggeessaniiru. Gareewwan gara bitaatti kan hidhatan hiriira kana durfaniiru; isaanis murteen mootummaan baajata irratti godhe maatiiwwan hojjettootaa irratti miidhaa geessisaa jira jedhanii mormaniiru. Hiriirtonni kun siyaasa dinagdee mootummaan ammaa hordofaa jiru irratti mormii cimaa qaban ibsaniiru.

title: Eighteen suspects extradited to US over Haitian president’s 2021 killing
english: Eighteen suspects have been transferred from Haiti to Florida to face trial for their alleged roles in the 2021 assassination of President Jovenel Moïse. This move represents a significant step in the ongoing U.S. federal investigation into the transnational conspiracy that led to the leader's death. Officials emphasized their commitment to pursuing justice against everyone involved in funding or carrying out the plot, noting that further legal actions are expected.
amharic: የሃይቲው ፕሬዚዳንት ጆቨኔል ሞይስ በ2021 መገደል ጋር በተያያዘ የተጠረጠሩ አስራ ስምንት ግለሰቦች ከሃይቲ ወደ አሜሪካ ፍሎሪዳ ተላልፈው ተሰጥተዋል። ተጠርጣሪዎቹ ግድያውን ለመፈጸም በተዘጋጀው ዓለም አቀፍ ሴራ ውስጥ በመሳተፋቸው በፌዴራል ፍርድ ቤት ቀርበው ይዳኛሉ። የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት በግድያው ዙሪያ እጃቸው ያለበትን እና ለተግባሩ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ ያደረጉትን ሁሉ ለፍርድ ለማቅረብ እንደሚሰሩ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Namoonni 18 ta’an kanneen bara 2021 ajjeechaa pirezidaantii Hayitii Joovenel Mooyiiseetiin shakkamanii turan gara Yunaayitid Isteets, biyya Ameerikaatti ergameera. Shakkamtoonni kun ajjeechaa kana keessatti hirmaachuu isaaniitiin dhaabbata mana murtii federaalaa Folooridaatti dhiyaachuuf jiru. Abbootiin alangaa Ameerikaa ajjeechaa kana kan karoorfanii fi maallaqa itti dhangalaasan hundaa seeraatti dhiyeessuuf kutannoo qabaachuu isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: Qatar PM describes fallout of US-Israel war on Iran as ‘earthquake’
english: Qatar's Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani has warned that the ongoing conflict between the US, Israel, and Iran is causing severe regional and global instability, which he likened to an earthquake. He emphasized that lasting security in the Middle East requires mutual respect for national sovereignty and a commitment to addressing the root causes of regional tensions. In response to these challenges, Qatar announced a $38 billion domestic infrastructure investment plan to boost its economic resilience.
amharic: የኳታር ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሼክ መሐመድ ቢን አብዱልረህማን ቢን ጃሲም አል ታኒ፣ በአሜሪካ፣ በእስራኤል እና በኢራን መካከል ያለው ግጭት በክልሉ እና በአለም ላይ ትልቅ መናጋትን እየፈጠረ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። በሜድል ኢስት ዘላቂ ሰላም እንዲሰፍን ሀገራት የአንዳቸውን ሉዓላዊነት ማክበር እንዳለባቸው እና የግጭቱን መሰረታዊ መንስኤዎች መፍታት እንደሚያስፈልግ አሳስበዋል። ለዚህም ምላሽ፣ ኳታር የኢኮኖሚ ጥንካሬዋን ለመጠበቅ በሚል የ38 ቢሊዮን ዶላር የሀገር ውስጥ የመሰረተ ልማት ግንባታ እቅድ ይፋ አድርጋለች።
oromo: Mummichi Ministeeraa Qatar Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani, waraanni Amerikaa, Israa'elii fi Iraan gidduutti adeemaa jiru naannichaa fi addunyaa irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisaa jiraachuu ibsanii jiru. Nageenyi idil-addunyaa fi naannichaa akka mirkanaa'uuf, biyyoonni tokko kan biraa kabajuu fi madda waraanaa kanaa furuun akka barbaachisu dhaamaniiru. Rakkoo kana dandamachuufis, Qatar dinagdee ishee cimsuuf sagantaa ijaarsa bu'uuraalee misoomaa biyya keessaa kan dolaara biiliyoona 38 ta'u ifoomsiteetti.

title: US, China open high-level talks ahead of Trump-Xi summit
english: Top economic officials from the US and China have begun high-level discussions in New York to prepare for a meeting between President Donald Trump and President Xi Jinping later this week. The talks focus on addressing trade tensions, including a potential extension of a trade truce and concerns over the supply of critical minerals. Additionally, the representatives are exploring collaborative safety standards for artificial intelligence to mitigate global security risks.
amharic: የአሜሪካ እና የቻይና ከፍተኛ የኢኮኖሚ ባለሥልጣናት በዚህ ሳምንት መጨረሻ ለሚከናወነው የፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ እና የፕሬዚዳንት ዢ ጂንፒንግ ውይይት ዝግጅት በኒውዮርክ የንግግር መድረክ ከፍተዋል። ንግግሮቹ የንግድ ውጥረቶችን በመቀነስ፣ የንግድ ስምምነቶችን በማራዘም እና ወሳኝ ማዕድናት አቅርቦት ላይ ያተኮሩ ናቸው። በተጨማሪም ሁለቱ ወገኖች ሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎትን (AI) ደህንነቱ በተጠበቀ ሁኔታ ለመጠቀም የሚያስችሉ የጋራ መመሪያዎችን ለመንደፍ እየመከሩ ነው።
oromo: Hoggantoonni dinagdee olaanoo Ameerikaa fi Chaayinaa, torbee kana dhufuuf kan karoorfame walgahii Pireezidaant Doonaald Traampii fi Pireezidaant Zii Jiinpiing qopha'uuf Niiw Yoorkitti marii jalqabaniiru. Mariin kun walitti bu'iinsa daldalaa tasgabbeessuu, waliigaltee daldalaa dheeressuu fi dhiyeessii ma'idana barbaachisoo irratti kan xiyyeeffate dha. Kana malees, gamtaan lameen hubannoo 'artificial intelligence' (AI) fayyadamuu irratti qaawwaa fi nageenya eeguuf mari'achaa jiru.

title: How will Saudi Arabia deal with the Houthis?
english: Violent confrontations have escalated between Saudi Arabia and the Iran-backed Houthi rebels in Yemen for the first time since the 2022 ceasefire. The Houthis recently launched missiles toward Riyadh, warning that any further military pressure will be met with stronger retaliatory strikes. This growing tension creates significant concern that the regional instability could worsen and draw other neighboring nations into the conflict.
amharic: ከ2022 የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ወዲህ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በሳውዲ አረቢያ እና በየመን ሁቲ ታጣቂዎች መካከል ያለው ግጭት ተባብሷል። በኢራን የሚደገፉት ሁቲዎች ወደ ሳውዲ ዋና ከተማ ሪያድ ሚሳኤሎችን የከፈቱ ሲሆን፣ በቀጣይም ተጨማሪ ጥቃት ከገጠማቸው አጸፋዊ እርምጃ እንደሚወስዱ አስጠንቅቀዋል። ይህ እየጨመረ የመጣ ውጥረት ቀጠናዊ አለመረጋጋትን በማባባስ ሌሎች ጎረቤት አገራትንም ወደ ግጭቱ ሊያስገባ ይችላል የሚል ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Waraanni biyyoota Saudii Arabiyaa fi garee Huthota Yemen gidduu jiru erga bara 2022 walii galtee dhaabbii waraanaa booda yeroo jalqabaaf hammaateera. Huthonni kanneen Iran irraa deeggarsa argatan, gara magaalaa guddittii Riyaditti misaa'ela kan dhukaasan yoo ta'u, tarkaanfiin waraanaa itti fufee itti dhufe akka hammaatu akeekkachiisaniiru. Walitti bu'iinsi kun naannichatti tasgabbii dhabuu fi biyyoota ollaa kan biraas gara waraanaatti harkisuu akka danda'u yaaddoon jira.

title: Man Utd salvage Fulham draw as pressure mounts on Carrick
english: Manchester United managed to secure a 1-1 draw against Fulham following a late goal by Matheus Cunha, avoiding a third consecutive loss. Despite the result, the team's poor performance has increased the pressure on manager Michael Carrick, who is currently struggling to produce consistent results. With only one win in their last five league matches, the club is falling behind their competitors, leaving the manager’s future under intense public scrutiny.
amharic: ማንችስተር ዩናይትድ በፈረንጆቹ እሁድ ከፉልሃም ጋር ባደረገው ጨዋታ ማቴውስ ኩንሃ በመጨረሻዎቹ ደቂቃዎች ባስቆጠራት ግብ አቻ በመውጣት ሽንፈትን ተርፏል። ውጤቱ ቢኖርም፣ የቡድኑ ደካማ አቋም በአሰልጣኝ ሚካኤል ካሪክ ላይ ያለው ጫና እንዲጨምር አድርጓል። ባለፉት አምስት የሊግ ጨዋታዎች አንድ ጊዜ ብቻ ማሸነፍ የቻለው ዩናይትድ፣ ከአመራር ደረጃው መራቁን ተከትሎ የአሰልጣኙ የወደፊት ዕጣ ፈንታ አጠያያቂ ሆኗል።
oromo: Manchester United tapha Fulham waliin taasisan irratti goolii dhumarratti Matheus Cunha galcheen qabxii tokko qooddachuu danda'aniiru. Bu'aan kun injifatamuu lammaffaa irraa isaan oolche iyyuu, taphataan sun ammas dhiibbaa cimaa jalatti akka jiran taasiiseera. Manchester United taphoota shanan darban keessaa injifannoo tokko qofa waan argateef, akkaataa leenjisaa Michael Carrick itti jiran irratti shakkiin guddaan uumameera.

title: Gaza artists honour Macklemore for supporting Palestine
english: Artists living in Gaza are creating murals on the ruins of destroyed buildings to express their gratitude toward American rapper Macklemore. They are honoring the musician for his vocal advocacy and public support for the Palestinian cause. This artistic tribute comes as the region continues to endure ongoing military strikes and violence.
amharic: በጋዛ የሚገኙ አርቲስቶች አሜሪካዊው ራፐር ማክለሞር ለፍልስጤም ላሳየው ድጋፍ ያላቸውን አድናቆት ለመግለጽ በተፈራረሱ ግድግዳዎች ላይ ስዕሎችን እየሳሉ ነው። ሙዚቀኛው ለፍልስጤም ህዝብ ላደረገው የድጋፍ ድምፅ ያላቸውን ክብር በዚህ መልኩ እየገለጹ ይገኛሉ። ይህ የጥበብ ስራ የተከናወነው ክልሉ አሁንም በጦርነት እና በተደጋጋሚ ጥቃቶች ውስጥ ባለበት ወቅት ነው።
oromo: Artistoonni Gaza keessa jiraatan, rapperii Ameerikaa Macklemore gargaarsa inni sababa Palastiniif godheef galata isaanii ibsuuf dallaa diigame irratti suuraa kaasaa jiru. Artistoonni kun aartisticha deeggarsa inni ifatti Palastiniif godheef kabaja isaanii ibsaa jiru. Hojiin aartii kun kan raawwatame yeroo naannichi waraanaa fi haleellaa itti fufiinsa qabu keessa jiruudha.

title: Jerusalem Daily: Israel pardons soldier Elor Azaria
english: Israeli President Isaac Herzog has granted a pardon to Elor Azaria, a former soldier previously convicted for the 2016 killing of an incapacitated Palestinian man. This decision comes as many Jewish Israelis gather at the Western Wall for prayers leading up to the Yom Kippur holiday. The news of the pardon has emerged alongside various international updates reported by Al Jazeera.
amharic: የእስራኤል ፕሬዝዳንት ይስሃቅ ሄርዞግ እ.ኤ.አ በ2016 ጉዳት የደረሰበትን ፍልስጤማዊ በመግደሉ የተከሰሰውን የቀድሞ ወታደር ኤሎር አዛሪያን ይቅርታ አድርገውለታል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተወሰነው ብዙ እስራኤላውያን ለዮም ኪፑር በዓል በምዕራባዊው ግንብ ለጸሎት በተሰበሰቡበት ወቅት ነው። ይህ መረጃ ከአልጀዚራ የተገኙ ሌሎች ዓለም አቀፍ ዜናዎች ጋር አብሮ የተዘገበ ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Israa'el Isaak Herzoog loltuu duraanii Elor Azariyaa kan bara 2016 namicha Falasxiin miidhame ajjeeseef dhiifama godhaniiru. Murteen kun kan darbe yeroo Israa'eloonni baay'een ayyaana Yoom Kiipuur ilaalchisee gara Dallaa Dhihaatti kadhataaf walitti qabamanitti. Gabaasni dhiifama kanaa oduuwwan biroo Al-Jaziiraan gabaafaman waliin dhihaateera.

title: Trump tariffs hit Canada’s dairy farmers as US sales stall
english: Canadian dairy farmers are facing significant challenges after the United States imposed a 50 percent tariff on their products in August. This trade barrier has severely reduced demand, leaving producers struggling to find new markets for their excess supply. Farmers warn that if the situation does not stabilize, they may be forced to discard milk or downsize their herds because production cannot be easily halted.
amharic: የካናዳ የወተት አምራቾች አሜሪካ በነሐሴ ወር በወተት ውጤቶች ላይ የጣለችውን የ50 በመቶ የጉምሩክ ቀረጥ ተከትሎ ከፍተኛ ችግር ውስጥ ገብተዋል። ይህ የንግድ ገደብ የገበያ ፍላጎትን በእጅጉ የቀነሰ ሲሆን፣ አምራቾችም ትርፍ ምርታቸውን የሚሸጡበት አማራጭ ለማግኘት ተቸግረዋል። አርሶ አደሮቹም ችግሩ ካልተፈታ ምርታቸውን መጣል ወይም የእንስሳት ቁጥራቸውን መቀነስ ሊገደዱ እንደሚችሉ አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Qonnaan bultoonni aannanii Kaanaadaa, ji'a Hagayya keessa Ameerikaan gatii aannanii irratti gibira dhibbeentaa 50 erra kaa'te booda rakkoo cimaa keessa galaniiru. Dhorkaan daldalaa kun fedhii gabaa hir'isuun, oomishtoonni aannanii isaan dabalataa gabaa biraatti gurguruu akka dadhaban taasiseera. Haalli kun yoo tasgabbaa'uu baate, qonnaan bultoonni oomisha aannanii gatuuf ykn lakkoofsa loonii hir'isuuf akka dirqaman hubachiisaniiru.

title: Central Colombia forest fire threatens tourist town of Villa de Leyva
english: A large wildfire is currently burning in the hills near the popular tourist destination of Villa de Leyva in central Colombia. The government has mobilized aircraft, military helicopters, and specialized firefighting teams from across the country to protect the historical town from the spreading flames. This incident is part of a broader national crisis, as extreme drought and high temperatures driven by the El Nino weather pattern have sparked multiple fires throughout the region.
amharic: በመካከለኛው ኮሎምቢያ በሚገኘው ታዋቂው የቱሪስት ከተማ ቪላ ደ ሌይቫ አቅራቢያ ከፍተኛ የእሳት አደጋ ተከስቷል። መንግስት ታሪካዊቷን ከተማ ከእሳት አደጋ ለመከላከል የአውሮፕላን ድጋፍ፣ የወታደራዊ ሄሊኮፕተሮችን እና ተጨማሪ የእሳት አደጋ መከላከያ ሰራተኞችን ወደ ስፍራው ልኳል። ይህ አደጋ በአገሪቱ ውስጥ የተከሰቱ በርካታ የእሳት አደጋዎች አካል ሲሆን፣ በኤል ኒኖ የአየር ንብረት ክስተት ምክንያት የተፈጠረው ድርቅ እና ከፍተኛ ሙቀት ሁኔታውን አባብሶታል።
oromo: Koolombiyaa giddu galeessaatti, magaalaa tuuristii bekamtuu Villa de Leyva jedhamtu biratti ibidni bosonaa guddaan ka'ee jira. Mootummaan magaalaa seena qabeettii tana balaa kana irraa oolchuuf xiyyaarota, helikopteroota waraanaa fi garee dhaamsitoota ibiddaa biyyattii irraa walitti babbahan gara sana ergeera. Balaan kun rakkoo biyyaalessaa kanneen biroo wajjin wal qabatu yoo ta'u, jijjiiramni qilleensaa fi sababa El Nino'n ho'inni cimaan fi gogiinsi uumame ibidda kana babal'isaa jira.

title: Atletico Madrid beat 10-man Real Madrid 2-1 in feisty La Liga derby
english: Atletico Madrid defeated a ten-man Real Madrid 2-1 in a tense La Liga derby. The turning point occurred early in the second half when Dean Huijsen was red-carded for a foul, allowing Alejandro Grimaldo to score from the resulting penalty. Jonathan David added a second goal for Atletico, and despite a late effort from Antonio Rudiger, Real Madrid fell to their second defeat of the season.
amharic: አትሌቲኮ ማድሪድ በአስር ተጫዋቾች በተገደበው ሪያል ማድሪድ ላይ በላ ሊጋው የደርቢ ጨዋታ 2 ለ 1 አሸንፏል። የጨዋታው መለያ ነጥብ በሁለተኛው አጋማሽ መጀመሪያ ላይ ዲን ሁይሰን በቀይ ካርድ ከሜዳ መውጣቱን ተከትሎ አሌሃንድሮ ግሪማልዶ በፍጹም ቅጣት ምት ግብ ማስቆጠሩ ነው። ጆናታን ዴቪድ ለአትሌቲኮ ሁለተኛዋን ግብ ያስቆጠረ ሲሆን፣ አንቶኒዮ ሩዲገርም ለሪያል ማድሪድ አንድ ግብ ቢመልስም ቡድኑ በውድድር ዘመኑ ሁለተኛ ሽንፈቱን አስተናግዷል።
oromo: Atleetikoon Maadriid garee Real Maadriid taphataa tokko hir’ate 2-1n mo’achuun danda’eera. Murtii game-ichaa kan jijjiire yeroo Dean Huijsen kaardiin diimaa ba’uun isaa fi Alejandro Grimaldo pheenaltii argame fayyadamuun goolii jalqabaa galchuun isaa ture. Jonathan David goolii lammaffaa Atleetikootiif galcheera; Antonio Rudiger xumura irratti goolii tokko galchullee, Real Maadriid injifannoo argachuu dadhabee yeroo lammaffaaf mo’atameera.

title: Photos: Nepal flood survivors find little trace of former lives
english: Devastating flash floods and mudslides in Nepal, triggered by a glacial collapse, have killed over 1,300 people and left thousands missing. Survivors returning to their homes in areas like Betrawati are finding nothing but debris, with many families losing both their loved ones and their land. This catastrophe has left the affected communities struggling to cope, as the total destruction has erased not only their homes but their sense of future security.
amharic: በኔፓል በተከሰተ የበረዶ ግግር መደርመስ ምክንያት የተፈጠረው ጎርፍና የመሬት መንሸራተት ከ1,300 በላይ ሰዎችን የገደለ ሲሆን በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችንም አጠፋፍቷል። ቤታቸው ወደተመለሱት ተጎጂዎች ስንመለከት፣ ቤታቸው በደለል ተቀብሮና ንብረታቸውም ወድሞ አግኝተውታል። ይህ ከፍተኛ አደጋ ብዙ ቤተሰቦችን ከማፈናቀሉም በላይ የኑሮ መሰረታቸውን በማውደሙ ለወደፊቱ ያላቸውን ተስፋ አጨልሞታል።
oromo: Neepaal keessatti balaa cabiinsa caba caba (glacial collapse) irraa ka'een lolaa fi manca'iinsi lafaa namoota 1,300 ol ajjeesee, kumaatamaan kan lakkaa'aman ammoo akka badanii fi maqaan isaanii hin beekamne godheera. Namoonni balaa kanaan miidhaman gara mana isaanii deebi'an, manni isaanii dhoqqee fi manca'iinsaan uwwifamee waan argataniif, qabeenyaa fi jaallatamoota isaanii dhabuun isaanii isaan miidheera. Balaan kun jireenya jiraattotaa guutummaatti kan diige yoo ta'u, dhaloota dhufuufis abdii kan kutachiise ta'uun ibsameera.

title: Kenya’s Ngetich breaks women-only half-marathon world record by a second
english: Kenyan athlete Agnes Ngetich set a new world record for the women-only half-marathon in Copenhagen, finishing with a time of one hour, five minutes, and 15 seconds. She beat the previous record by one second and finished 50 seconds ahead of her fellow Kenyan competitor, Veronica Loleo. This achievement adds to an impressive year for the 25-year-old runner, who has already secured victories in the World Cross Country Championships and team events.
amharic: የኬንያዊቷ አትሌት አግነስ ንጌቲች በኮፐንሃገን በተካሄደው የሴቶች ብቻ ግማሽ ማራቶን ውድድር በአንድ ሰዓት ከአምስት ደቂቃ ከ15 ሰከንድ በመጨረስ አዲስ የዓለም ክብረ ወሰን አስመዝግባለች። ቀደም ሲል የነበረውን ክብረ ወሰን በአንድ ሰከንድ ያሻሻለችው ንጌቲች፣ ሁለተኛ የወጣችውን አገሯን ቬሮኒካ ሎሌኦን በ50 ሰከንድ ቀድማለች። ይህ ድል በአመቱ የዓለም የጎዳና ላይ ሩጫ ውድድር እና የዓለም የክርሮስ ካንትሪ ሻምፒዮናን ጨምሮ በርካታ ድሎችን ያስመዘገበችው የ25 ዓመቷ አትሌት የላቀ ብቃት ማሳያ ነው።
oromo: Atileetiin Keeniyaa Agnes Ngetich sagantaa fiigicha walakkaa maaraatoonii dubartoota qofa irratti Kopenheeganitti gaggeeffame irratti sa’aatii tokko, daqiiqaa shan fi sekondii 15 keessatti xumuruun riikardii addunyaa haaraa galteetti. Ngetich riikardii kanaan dura ture sekondii tokkoon kan fooyyessite yoo ta’u, dorgomtuu ishee biyya ishee Keeniyaa irraa taate Veroniikaa Loleoo sekondii 50 dura buuteetti. Injifannoon kun atleetii umuriin ishee 25 ta’e kanaaf, bara kana keessa Shaampiyoonaa Ardii fi fiigicha addunyaa irratti milkaa’ina gurguddaa argatteef dabalee kan itti dabalame dha.

title: Trump says his planned triumphal arch will double as a military complex to store ammunition
english: President Trump has announced updated plans for his proposed 250-foot triumphal arch to serve as a high-tech military facility. He claims the structure will house ammunition and provide tactical capabilities for deploying snipers and drones for national security. While construction is intended to start near Arlington, official details regarding approvals and timelines remain unclear.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ሊገነቡት ያቀዱት 250 ጫማ ከፍታ ያለው ድል አድራጊ ቅስት (triumphal arch) የወታደራዊ መሣሪያዎች ማከማቻ ሆኖ እንዲያገለግል ማሻሻያ ማድረጋቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ሕንፃ ጥይቶችን ከመያዙም በላይ ለስናይፐሮች እና ድሮኖች መጠቀሚያነት የሚያገለግል የወታደራዊ ደህንነት ማዕከል እንደሚሆን ገልጸዋል። የፕሮጀክቱ ግንባታ ከአርሊንግተን አጠገብ እንደሚጀመር ቢነገርም፣ ስለ ፈቃድ አሰጣጡ እና ስለ ጊዜ ሰሌዳው የተሟላ መረጃ እስካሁን የለም።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Traamp gamoowwan garraamii mo'ichaa (triumphal arch) miira 250 dheeratu ijaaruuf qophaa'an, lafa meeshaalee waraanaa fi buufata waraanaa ta'ee akka tajaajiluuf jijjiirama gochuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Gamoowwan kun meeshaalee waraanaa keessatti akka kuufamuufi, akkasumas lafa snayiperootaa fi droonota itti fayyadaman ta'ee akka tajaajilu himaniiru. Ijaarsi kun Arliingitaniin cinaatti akka eegalamu kan yaadame ta'us, hayyama fi yeroo ijaarsaa irratti odeeffannoon guutuun hanga ammaa hin jiru.

title: Hundreds protest in Tunisia for release of jailed Gaza flotilla activists
english: Hundreds of protesters gathered in Tunis to call for the release of four activists associated with the Global Sumud Flotilla. These individuals have been held in detention since March due to accusations regarding financial irregularities connected to an aid mission to Gaza. The demonstrators are urging authorities to free the activists who were involved in the effort to deliver humanitarian supplies.
amharic: በቱኒዚያ ዋና ከተማ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች የግሎባል ሱሙድ ፍሎቲላ አክቲቪስቶች እንዲለቀቁ በመጠየቅ ሰልፍ ወጥተዋል። አራቱ ግለሰቦች ወደ ጋዛ እርዳታ ለማድረስ በተደረገ ጥረት ላይ የገንዘብ ብልሹ አሠራር ፈጽመዋል በሚል ከመጋቢት ወር ጀምሮ በእስር ላይ ይገኛሉ። ሰልፈኞቹ እነዚህን የሰብዓዊ እርዳታ አቅራቢ አክቲቪስቶች መንግሥት በአስቸኳይ እንዲፈታ ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Tuniziyaatti namoonni dhibbaan lakkaa’aman miseensota 'Global Sumud Flotilla' afran hidhaman akka gadhiifaman gaafachuun hiriira bahaniiru. Namoonni kunneen gara Gaazaatti gargaarsa namoomaa geessuuf yaalii taasisan irratti malaammaltummaa maallaqaa raawwataniiru jedhamanii marsaa Bitootessaa irraa jalqabee hidhaa keessa turaniiru. Hiriirtonni kunneen namoota gargaarsa namoomaa geessuuf socho’aa turan kun hatattamaan akka hiikaman mootummaa gaafachaa jiru.

title: Humanoid robots fight in cage match in Shanghai
english: In Shanghai, AI-driven humanoid robots recently competed in a unique cage fighting event. Organized by the Ultimate Robot Knock-out Legend league, the match showcased the physical capabilities of advanced machines in a combat setting. This event highlights the growing intersection of robotics technology and competitive entertainment.
amharic: በሻንጋይ ከተማ በሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት የሚሰሩ ሂውማኖይድ ሮቦቶች በአይነቱ ልዩ የሆነ የካጅ ጦርነት አድርገዋል። የኡልቲሜት ሮቦት ኖክ-አውት ሌጀንድ ሊግ ባዘጋጀው በዚህ ውድድር፣ ሮቦቶቹ በተዘጋ ቦታ ውስጥ አካላዊ ጥንካሬያቸውን አሳይተዋል። ይህ ክስተት የሮቦቲክስ ቴክኖሎጂ እና የመዝናኛ ውድድሮች እየተቀራረቡ መምጣታቸውን ያሳያል።
oromo: Finfinnee Shanghai keessatti, roobonni nama fakkaatan kanneen 'Artificial Intelligence' fayyadamanii socho'an, dorgommii qabsoo kage keessatti wal lolaniiru. Dorgommiin kun kan qophaa'e liigii 'Ultimate Robot Knock-out Legend' jedhamuun yoo ta'u, dandeettii qaamaa roobonni kun qaban agarsiiseera. Taateen kun guddina teeknoolojii roobootiksii fi dorgommii bashannansiisaa walitti dhufeenya qabaachuu isaa mul'isa.

title: The pro-Israel censors are starting to lose
english: The recent removal of rapper Macklemore from Ed Sheeran's tour due to his pro-Palestine stance backfired, sparking a wave of support for his cause. Several other artists withdrew from the tour in protest, while ticket sales suffered significant losses. Ultimately, these events brought increased attention and financial aid to Palestinian humanitarian efforts, signaling a weakening in the ability to suppress pro-Palestine narratives.

title: Jews and Muslims lived together for centuries. Did Zionism tear them apart?
english: A recent podcast episode explores the historical relationship between Jewish and Muslim communities, noting that they coexisted peacefully for many centuries in various regions. The discussion highlights the perspective of the Neturei Karta, an Orthodox Jewish group that opposes Zionism on religious grounds. The program examines how the emergence of the modern Jewish state and Zionist ideology altered long-standing communal ties.

title: What’s behind Iranian authorities’ push for a mass mobilisation campaign?
english: Iranian authorities have launched a nationwide recruitment campaign called 'Janfada' to train and arm civilian volunteers as part of the IRGC's Basij militia. The movement, which displays military weaponry on public banners, aims to bolster state security amid ongoing regional tensions with the United States and Israel. While officials claim high participation numbers, the initiative has drawn skepticism and international concern regarding its true scale and intent.

Mootummaan Iraan kun kan godhame waraana Amerikaa fi Israa'el waliin jiruun wal-qabatee nageenya biyyattii cimsuuf akka ta'e ibseera, haa ta'u malee lakkoofsi namoota hirmaachuu jedhame kun addunyaa irratti gaaffii guddaa kaaseera.

title: Iran military warns middle eastern nations 'complicit' if US resumes attacks from American bases
english: The Iranian military has cautioned neighboring countries that they will be held responsible if they allow the United States to launch attacks against Iran from their territories. This warning follows increasing regional tensions, particularly involving Houthi activities targeting Saudi Arabia. Iran is effectively demanding that regional powers prevent their military infrastructure from being used in any potential American offensive.

Iraan biyyoonni naannichaa buufata waraanaa isaanii haleellaa Amerikaa irratti akka hin oolchineef gaaffii dhiheessiteetti.

title: Israeli president pardons soldier convicted for killing wounded Palestinian
english: Israeli President Isaac Herzog has granted a pardon to Elor Azaria, a former soldier previously convicted of killing a wounded Palestinian man in 2016. This decision effectively clears Azaria’s criminal record, a move justified by the President as an act of reconciliation during the holiday season. The pardon has been controversial, as it went against the explicit recommendation of the Israeli military leadership, who argued that the former soldier failed to show genuine remorse for his actions.

Haa ta'u malee, ajajaan waraana Israa'el loltuun kun gocha isaa irratti gaabbiin dhugaa mul'isuu dhabuu isaa himuun dhiifamichi akka hin godhamne gorsa kennanii turan; kanaafuu murteen pirezedantichaa mormii cimaa uumeera.

title: Qatar condemns Houthi attacks on Riyadh and civilian infrastructure in Yemen
english: Qatar has officially denounced recent Houthi missile strikes targeting Saudi Arabia’s capital and various civilian locations. The Qatari government labeled these actions as illegal violations of sovereignty and international norms. Expressing full support for Saudi security measures, Qatar demanded an immediate end to all attacks against non-military targets.

Qatar nageenya Saudii Arabiyaaf deggarsa guutuu qabdu mirkaneessuun, haleellaan siviilota irratti raawwatamu hatattamaan akka dhaabbatu gaafatteetti.

title: Israeli minister Ben Gvir enters Al-Aqsa courtyard again amid tensions
english: Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir visited the Al-Aqsa Mosque compound in East Jerusalem under police protection this Sunday. This marks his second visit in recent weeks, during which he reportedly conducted prohibited prayers at the site. These actions have sparked controversy as they violate the established agreement that limits non-Muslim activities to visits only, excluding prayer.

Kun torbanoota darban keessa yeroo lammaffaadhaaf gara dirree sanaa kan seenan yoo ta'u, achittis kadhannaa dhoorkaa ta'e raawwachuun isaanii gabaafameera. Gochi kun namoonni muslima hin taane bakka sanatti akka hin kadhanne seerota durii irraa ture kan cabsu waan ta'eef, mormii guddaa kaaseera.

title: US and Saudi Arabia lack plan as Houthi strikes expose Riyadh's vulnerability
english: Saudi Arabia and the U.S. currently lack a cohesive strategy to counter the Houthi rebels, who have intensified attacks by firing missiles at Riyadh and other key Saudi locations. Despite years of American training and intelligence support, Saudi forces have struggled to contain the group's growing influence along the Red Sea coast. The recent escalation, involving fires near an airport and threats to vital shipping lanes, has highlighted significant gaps in regional security.

Ameerikaan gargaarsaafi odeeffannoo kennuufii iyyuu, waraanni Sa’udii garee kana to’achuu irratti rakkoo guddaa keessa jira. Haleellaan garee Huutii dhiheenya kana magaalota gurguddoo fi daandiiwwan daldalaa galaana diimaa irratti raawwatan, hanqina nageenyaa naannichaa ifa baasee jira.

title: German elections under way which could decide fate of Chancellor Merz
english: Voters in Berlin and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern are heading to the polls in regional elections that could determine the political future of Chancellor Friedrich Merz. The Chancellor's Christian Democratic Union (CDU) party is polling poorly, sparking rumors that he might be replaced if the results are as negative as expected. Meanwhile, the far-right AfD party is gaining momentum across Germany, putting additional pressure on the current conservative leadership.
amharic: በርሊን እና ሜክለንበርግ-ቮርፖመርን በተካሄዱት ክልላዊ ምርጫዎች የጀርመኑ ቻንስለር ፍሪድሪች ሜርዝ የፖለቲካ የወደፊት ዕጣ ፈንታ አደጋ ላይ ወድቋል። የቻንስለሩ የክርስቲያን ዴሞክራቲክ ዩኒየን (CDU) ፓርቲ በምርጫው ዝቅተኛ ድጋፍ እያሳየ በመሆኑ፣ ውጤቱ የከፋ ከሆነ ከስልጣን ሊነሱ እንደሚችሉ የሚገልጹ ግምቶች እየተሰሙ ነው። በሌላ በኩል የቀኝ ዘመም አክራሪው የአፍዲ (AfD) ፓርቲ በጀርመን እያገኘ ያለው ተቀባይነት በአሁኑ አመራር ላይ ከፍተኛ ጫና ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Filannoon naannolee Berlin fi Mecklenburg-Vorpommern gaggeeffamaa jiru gara fuulduraa kan ministira muummee biyyattii Friedrich Merz murteessuu danda'a. Paartiin ministirichaa kan CDU jedhamu deggarsa guddaa dhabuun isaa fi bu'aan filannoo kun haalaan badaa ta'uun isaa, ministirichi aangoo gadhiisuu danda'a jedhanii akka yaadamu taasiseera. Gamtaan, paartiin fa'a-mirgaa AfD jedhamu biyyattii keessatti hordoftoota horachuun isaa, mootummaa ammaa irratti dhiibbaa cimaa uumeera.

title: Trump’s Greenland deal: A triumph of optics?
english: A new security agreement between the United States, Denmark, and Greenland aims to stabilize regional tensions and protect Greenland's sovereignty. While President Trump frames the deal as a major victory, critics argue it offers little that wasn't already covered by previous defense treaties. The agreement notably grants the U.S. permanent status and new veto powers over foreign investments or military presence on the island.
amharic: በአሜሪካ፣ በዴንማርክ እና በግሪንላንድ መካከል የተፈረመው አዲሱ የጸጥታ ስምምነት በክልሉ የነበረውን ውጥረት ለማርገብ እና የግሪንላንድን ሉዓላዊነት ለማስከበር ያለመ ነው። ፕሬዚዳንት ትራምፕ ስምምነቱን እንደ ትልቅ ድል ቢቆጥሩትም፣ ነባር የጸጥታ ስምምነቶች ቀድሞውንም ተመሳሳይ መብቶችን ይሰጡ እንደነበር ተቺዎች ይናገራሉ። ይህ ስምምነት ለአሜሪካ ዘላቂ መብት የሚሰጥ ሲሆን፣ በግሪንላንድ ላይ ሌሎች አገራት የሚያደርጉትን ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ ወይም ኢንቨስትመንት የመቆጣጠር ስልጣን ይሰጣታል።
oromo: waliigalteen nageenyaa haaraan Ameerikaa, Deenmaarkii fi Giriinlaandii gidduutti taasifame, walitti bu'iinsa naannichaa tasgabbeessuu fi birmadummaa Giriinlaandii kabachiisuuf kan kaayyeffatedha. Pireezidaanti Traamp waliigaltee kana injifannoo guddaa akka ta'etti ibsaniyyuu, gariin namootaa waliigaltee kanaan dura turan faayidaa akkasii akka qaban dubbatu. Waliigalteen kun Ameerikaaf mirga yeroo dheeraa kennuun alatti, biyyoonni biroon Giriinlaandii keessatti sochii waraanaa ykn invastimantii akka hin taasifne to'achuuf aangoo akka argattu taasisa.

title: Turkish FM says ready to meet Saudi defence needs – what does that mean?
english: Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan has pledged to provide military and technical support to Saudi Arabia as it faces increasing missile and drone attacks from Houthi rebels. This commitment highlights the newly established Mecca Joint Defence Agreement, which requires member nations to defend one another if attacked. The move comes amid growing regional instability that is threatening Saudi infrastructure and global oil supply routes.
amharic: የቱርክ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ሃካን ፊዳን፣ ሳዑዲ አረቢያ በሁቲ አማፂያን እየደረሰባት ያለውን የሚሳኤልና የድሮን ጥቃት ለመመከት የሚያስፈልጋትን ወታደራዊና ቴክኒካዊ ድጋፍ ለማድረግ ዝግጁ መሆኗን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ ሀገራቱ በቅርቡ የተፈራረሙትን የሜካ የጋራ መከላከያ ስምምነት ተግባራዊነት የሚፈትሽ ሲሆን፣ በአባል ሀገራት ላይ የሚሰነዘር ጥቃት በሁሉም ላይ እንደተፈጸመ ይቆጠራል። ውጥረት ባየለበት በዚህ ወቅት፣ የሳዑዲን መሠረተ ልማቶችና የነዳጅ ማጓጓዣ መስመሮችን ለመጠበቅ የቱርክ ሚና ወሳኝ ሆኗል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Turkii Hakan Fidaan, Sa’udii Arabiyaan weerara misaa’elaa fi droonii finxaaleyyii Huutii irraa ishee mudatu ittisuuf gargaarsa waraanaa fi teeknikaa gochuuf qophiidha jedhan. Murteen kun walii galtee ittisa biyyaalessaa 'Mecca' kan biyyoonni kunneen dhiyeenya kana mallatteessan hojii irra oolchuuf kan kaayyeffatedha; walii galtichi weerarri miseensa tokko irratti gaggeeffamu akka weerara hundatti ilaallamu kan ibsudha. Yeroo ammaatti naannichatti rakkoon tasgabbii dhabuu dabalaa waan jiruuf, gargaarsi Turkii bu’uuraalee misoomaa fi daandii boba’aa Sa’udii eeguuf murteessaa dha.

title: Salah scores hat-trick as Trabzonspor beat Galatasaray in Turkish league
english: Mohamed Salah led Trabzonspor to a dominant 4-0 victory over defending champions Galatasaray by scoring a hat-trick and assisting the other goal. This impressive performance handed the Istanbul side their first loss of the season in the Turkish Super Lig. Despite the win, Galatasaray remains three points ahead of fifth-placed Trabzonspor in the league standings.
amharic: መሐመድ ሳላህ ለትራብዞንስፖር ሶስት ግቦችን በማስቆጠር እና አንድ ለግብ የሚሆን ኳስ አመቻችቶ በመስጠት ቡድኑ ጋላታሳራይን 4 ለ 0 እንዲያሸንፍ አድርጓል። ይህ ድል የቱርክ ሱፐር ሊግ መሪ የሆነው ጋላታሳራይ በዚህ የውድድር ዘመን የመጀመሪያ ሽንፈቱን እንዲቀምስ አድርጎታል። ምንም እንኳን ውጤቱ ይህ ቢሆንም፣ ጋላታሳራይ በሊጉ ደረጃ ከትራብዞንስፖር በሶስት ነጥብ ብልጫ አሁንም ቀዳሚነቱን ይዟል።
oromo: Mohamed Saalaah Trabzonspooriif goolii sadii galchuufi goolii afuraffaa irratti deeggarsa gochuun, gareen isaa Galaataasaaraay irratti injifannoo 4-0 gonfatee jira. Injifannoon kun Galaataasaaraay dorgommicharratti injifatamuu isaa jalqabaa akka ta'u taasiseera. Ta'us, Galaataasaaraay qabxii sadetiin liigicharratti hoggantummaa isaa itti fufee jira.

title: Asian Games: Smriti Mandhana breaks T20 record as India beat Bangladesh
english: India secured a spot in the Asian Games women's cricket final after a dominant 114-run victory over Bangladesh. During the match, Smriti Mandhana set a new record as the all-time leading run-scorer in women's T20 internationals, while Shafali Verma hit her first T20 century. India will face Sri Lanka in the gold medal match following Sri Lanka's win over Pakistan.
amharic: የህንድ የሴቶች ክሪኬት ቡድን ባንግላዴሽን በ114 ሩጫ በማሸነፍ የእስያ ጨዋታዎች የፍጻሜ ውድድር ላይ መድረስ ችሏል። በዚሁ ጨዋታ ስሚሪ ማንዳና በሴቶች ቲ20 ዓለም አቀፍ ውድድር ከፍተኛውን የሩጫ መጠን በማስመዝገብ አዲስ ክብረ ወሰን አስመዝግባለች፤ ሻፋሊ ቨርማም የመጀመሪያዋን የቲ20 ਸንቸሪ አስመዝግባለች። ህንድ በወርቅ ሜዳሊያ ጨዋታው ፓኪስታንን ካሸነፈችው سری ላንካ ጋር ትጋጠማለች።
oromo: Gareen kiriketi dubartoota Hindii biyya Baangilaadeshin goolii 114n mo’achuun gara injifannoo xumuraa taphoota Esiyaa darbeera. Tapha kana irratti, Smritii Maandhaan an tapha kiriketi dubartoota T20 idil-addunyaa irratti sadarkaa tokkoffaa qabachuun seenaa haaraa galchiteerti, akkasumas Shaafalii Vermaan seancharii ishee jalqabaa galchiteerti. Hindii tapha injifannoo warqee irratti garee Siri Laankaa isa Paakistaan mo’atee wajjin wal qunnamti.

title: ‘There will be a very sizeable Saudi response’ to Houthi attacks
english: A senior research fellow has stated that Saudi Arabia is planning a significant and coordinated retaliation against recent Houthi strikes originating from Yemen. The kingdom intends to work closely with its coalition allies to execute this major response. This announcement signals a likely escalation in the ongoing military tensions between the involved parties.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ ከየመን በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ለሚሰነዘሩባት ጥቃቶች ጠንካራ እና የተቀናጀ ምላሽ ለመስጠት እያቀደች መሆኑን አንድ የጥናት ባለሙያ ገልጸዋል። መንግስቱ ይህንን እርምጃ ከጥምረት አጋሮቹ ጋር በመተባበር እንደሚፈጽም ተነግሯል። ይህ መግለጫ በተቀናቃኞቹ መካከል ያለው ወታደራዊ ግጭት ወደፊት ሊባባስ እንደሚችል አመላካች ነው።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan haleellaa garee Huutii kan Yaman irraa ishee irratti gaggeeffamaa jiruuf deebii cimaa fi qindaa’aa ta’e kennuuf qophii irra akka jirtu ogeessi qorannoo tokko beeksisaniiru. Mootummichi deebii kana tumsa isaa waliin ta’uun kan raawwatu ta’uu ibsameera. Ibdi kun walitti bu’iinsa waraanaa gama lamaan gidduu jiru gara fuulduraatti kan hammeessuu danda’u ta’uu agarsiisa.

title: ‘Hyperzionism’: How Germany’s conflation of antisemitism and anti-Zionism allowed a far-right return
english: In Germany, political discourse has increasingly conflated anti-Zionism with antisemitism, leading to the suppression of pro-Palestinian voices and the ostracization of critics. This environment has allowed the far-right AfD party to reshape its image as a pro-Israel entity while deflecting blame for its own history of antisemitic hate crimes. Recent incidents, including a confrontation involving a Jewish pro-Palestinian activist, highlight the growing confusion and misuse of victimhood in the lead-up to significant political shifts.
amharic: ጀርመን ውስጥ የፀረ-ጽዮናዊነት አቋምን ከፀረ-ሴማዊነት ጋር ማያያዝ፣ የፍልስጤም ደጋፊ ድምፆችን ለማፈን እና ሃሳብን በነፃነት የመግለጽ መብት ላይ ተጽዕኖ እያሳደረ ይገኛል። የጀርመን የቀኝ ጽንፈኛ ፓርቲ (AfD) ይህንን ክፍተት በመጠቀም ራሱን የእስራኤል ደጋፊ በማስመሰል፣ በራሱ ላይ የሚነሳውን የፀረ-ሴማዊነት ክስ ለማዘናጋት እየሞከረ ነው። የቅርብ ጊዜ ክስተቶች እንደሚያሳዩት፣ የፖለቲካው ሁኔታ እየተዛባ መምጣቱ ለቀኝ ጽንፈኞች የፖለቲካ ትርፍ ማስገኛ ሆኗል።
oromo: Jarmanii keessatti yaada diinummaa Ziyoonizimii fi diinummaa Yihuudotaa (antisemitism) walitti makanii ilaaluun, sagalee degartoota Falasxiin ukkamsuu fi namoota yaada kana qaban cunqusuu fiduu irra jira. Paartiin mirga-qaxxaamuraa (far-right) AfD jedhamu carraa kanaan fayyadamee, ofii isaa akka degaraa Israa'elatti dhiyeessuun, seenaa isaa keessatti himannaa diinummaa Yihuudotaa irratti qabu dhoksuuf yaalaa jira. Taateewwan dhihoo kana mul'atan akka agarsiisanitti, jijjiiramni siyaasaa kun adeemsa dimokiraasii biyyattii irratti dhiibbaa geessisaa jira.

title: Netanyahu enters Western Wall plaza with thousands of Israelis, including ministers
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu joined thousands of Israelis and government ministers for a visit to the Western Wall in occupied East Jerusalem. The gathering occurred amid calls for religious rituals near the Al-Aqsa Mosque compound ahead of upcoming Jewish holidays. Meanwhile, many Palestinians were also present in the Old City for prayers and daily activities, causing a high-traffic environment in the area.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ በምስራቅ እየሩሳሌም በሚገኘው የሰቆቃው ግንብ ወይም ምዕራባዊ ግንብ አካባቢ በሺዎች ከሚቆጠሩ እስራኤላውያን እና የመንግስት ባለስልጣናት ጋር ተገኝተዋል። ይህ ጉብኝት የተካሄደው በአል-አቅሳ መስጊድ አካባቢ አይሁዶች ሃይማኖታዊ ስነ-ስርዓቶችን ለማከናወን ጥሪ ባደረጉበት ወቅት ነው። በተመሳሳይ ሰዓት በርካታ ፍልስጤማውያን በአካባቢው ለጸሎት እና ለገበያ በመገኘታቸው በከተማዋ መጨናነቅ ታይቷል።
oromo: Muummeen Ministira Israa'el Benyamin Netanyaahuun, hordoftoota amantii fi ministiroota mootummaa kumaatamaa wajjin magaalaa Yerusaalem bahaatti argamuun dallaa seena-qabeessa (Western Wall) daawwatan. Daawwannaan kun kan ta'e, hordoftoonni Yihuudii ayyaana itti aanuuf qophii godhachaa jiranitti, dhiyeenya masjiida Al-Aqsaa biratti sirna amantii gaggeessuuf waamicha erga taasisanii boodadha. Yeroo kana, Falastinoonni hedduunis salaata fi hojii daldalaaf bakka sanatti argamuun, naannichatti walitti dhufeenya uumameera.

title: Inside Somaliland: How Berbera Port is central to the Red Sea's power struggle
english: Berbera Port has become a crucial hub in the Red Sea's complex geopolitical landscape, serving as a primary economic engine for Somaliland. Managed by the UAE's DP World, the port has seen significant infrastructure investment that creates local jobs and facilitates international trade. Its growing strategic importance has drawn attention from various regional powers, making the area a focal point in broader political and security tensions.
amharic: የበርበራ ወደብ በቀይ ባህር አካባቢ ባለው የጂኦፖለቲካዊ ውጥረት ውስጥ ዋነኛ መገናኛ ሆኗል፤ ይህም ለሶማሌላንድ ኢኮኖሚ ትልቅ ሚና ይጫወታል። የተባበሩት አረብ ኤምሬቶች ዲፒ ወርልድ ኩባንያ ወደቡን በማዘመን ከፍተኛ የኢንቨስትመንት ሥራ በመስራቱ ለብዙ ሰዎች የሥራ ዕድል ተፈጥሯል። የዚህ ወደብ ስትራቴጂያዊ አስፈላጊነት በክልሉ ውስጥ ያሉ አገራትን ትኩረት በመሳቡ፣ አካባቢውን ለፖለቲካዊ እና ለደህንነት ውዝግቦች ማዕከል አድርጎታል።
oromo: Buufanni Berbera dhimma geopolitikii naannoo Galaana Diimaa keessatti bakka barbaachisaa ta'ee fi dinagdee Somalilandif utubaa guddaa dha. Dhaabbanni Emiratiin hoogganamu DP World, buufata kana fooyyessuun invastimantii guddaa waan seeneef, carraan hojii namoota hedduuf uumameera. Bakki kun bakka istiraatejii guddaa waan ta'eef, mootummoota naannichaa biratti xiyyeeffannoo argatee jira; kunis naannichi akka walitti bu'iinsa siyaasaa fi nageenyaa godhee jira.

title: Ghalibaf: Iran must ‘fight and negotiate’ as war with US drags on
english: Iran's parliament speaker, Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, stated that the country will pursue a dual strategy of military resistance and diplomatic negotiation during its ongoing conflict with the U.S. He emphasized that Iran will use force to gain an advantage while maintaining the closure of the Strait of Hormuz until American authorities meet specific demands. Tehran has reportedly set seven conditions that must be satisfied before any formal talks with Washington can take place.
amharic: የኢራን ፓርላማ አፈ ጉባኤ መሐመድ ባጌር ጋሊባፍ ከአሜሪካ ጋር ለሚደረገው ግጭት ወታደራዊ ኃይልንና ዲፕሎማሲን አቀናጅቶ መጠቀም እንደሚያስፈልግ ገልጸዋል። በጦር ሜዳ ብልጫ እስካላገኙ ድረስ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ እንደሚወስዱና የሆርሙዝ ባህር ሰላጤን እንደዘጉ እንደሚቀጥሉ አሳውቀዋል። ከዋሽንግተን ጋር ድርድር ከመጀመሩ በፊት ኢራን ያስቀመጠቻቸው ሰባት ቅድመ ሁኔታዎች መሟላት እንዳለባቸውም ተጠቅሷል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni mana maree biyyattii Iraan, Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, waraana Ameerikaa wajjin jiru keessatti humna waraanaatti fayyadamuu fi marii diplomasiitti gargaaramuun barbaachisaa ta'uu ibsan. Iraan bakka ishiin humna qabdu keessatti lola gaggeessuufi yoo ta'e, gama biraan ammoo hamma Ameerikaan fedhii isaanii guuttutti qarqara galaana Hormuz cufamee akka turu dubbataniiru. Kana malees, marii Ameerikaa wajjin jalqabuu dura, Iraan haala duraa torba guutuu akka qabdu beekameera.

title: Saudi Arabia withdraws from China-led digital currency platform
english: Saudi Arabia has ended its formal involvement in mBridge, a digital currency initiative led by China that aims to streamline international payments without relying on the US dollar. While the Saudi Central Bank stated they finished their planned research and testing phase in May 2025, some reports suggest the country may still be quietly connected to the project. The platform utilizes blockchain technology to help central banks process transactions more efficiently and directly.
amharic: ሳዑዲ አረቢያ ከአሜሪካ ዶላር ውጭ ዓለም አቀፍ የገንዘብ ዝውውሮችን ለማቀላጠፍ በቻይና የሚመራውን 'ኤምብሪጅ' (mBridge) የተሰኘ የዲጂታል ምንዛሬ መድረክ በይፋ ለቃለች። የሳዑዲ ማዕከላዊ ባንክ እንደገለጸው፣ ፕሮጀክቱ የተካሄደው ለምርምር ሥራ ብቻ እንደነበር እና ግንቦት 2017 ዓ.ም ላይ የተሰጠውን ተግባር በማጠናቀቃቸው ከፕሮጀክቱ ወጥተዋል። ይሁን እንጂ አንዳንድ መረጃዎች አገሪቱ አሁንም በስውር ከፕሮጀክቱ ጋር ግንኙነት ሊኖራት እንደሚችል ይጠቁማሉ። ይህ የብሎክቼይን ቴክኖሎጂን የሚጠቀም መድረክ ማዕከላዊ ባንኮች በቀጥታ ግብይት እንዲፈጽሙ በማድረግ ወጪን ለመቀነስ ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Saudii Arabaan sagantaa maallaqa dijitaalaa Chaayinaan durfamu kan 'mBridge' jedhamu irraa of duuba deebiteetti. Sagantaan kun kan qophaa'e maallaqa doolaara Ameerikaa fayyadamuu malee daldala biyyoota gidduu salphaa gochuuf ture. Baankii Giddugaleessa Saudi Arabaa akka ibsetti, hirmaannaan isaanii qorannoo qofaaf kan ture yoo ta'u, erga qorannicha xumuranii booda Sadaasa 2017 keessa saganticha keessaa bahan. Ta'us, gabaasawwan tokko tokko biyyattiin ammas gama biroon sagantichatti hidhata qabaachuu dandeessi jedhu.

title: Two killed in 'massive' Ukrainian drone attack on Moscow region, says Russia
english: A significant overnight Ukrainian drone attack on the Moscow region has resulted in the deaths of two people and injuries to several others. Russian officials reported that hundreds of drones were intercepted, though damage occurred to residential buildings, a warehouse, and an oil refinery. This escalation follows recent deadly Russian strikes on civilian areas in Ukraine, marking an intensification of cross-border hostilities.
amharic: ዩክሬን በሞስኮ አካባቢ ባደረሰችው መጠነ ሰፊ የድሮን ጥቃት ሁለት ሰዎች መገደላቸውንና በርካቶች መቁሰላቸውን የሩሲያ ባለስልጣናት አስታወቁ። የሩሲያ መከላከያ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ድሮኖችን መትተው መጣላቸውን ቢገልጽም፣ ጥቃቱ የመኖሪያ ቤቶችንና የነዳጅ ማጣሪያን ጨምሮ በበርካታ ንብረቶች ላይ ጉዳት አድርሷል። ይህ ክስተት በዩክሬን በኩል የተፈጸሙ ገዳይ ጥቃቶችን ተከትሎ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለው የጦርነት ውጥረት እየተባባሰ መምጣቱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Yukireeniin naannoo Moskootti haleellaa oronii cimaa ta'e raawwattee kanaan namoonni lama lubbuun darbuu fi kaan ammoo miidhamuu isaanii qondaalonni Raashiyaa beeksisaniiru. Raashiyaan oronii dhibbaan lakkaa'aman rukutamanii kufuun isaanii ibsituus, haleellaan kun manneen jireenyaa, bakka meeshaan itti kuufamu fi iddoo suphaa boba'aa irratti miidha geessiseera. Kunis, Yukireenitti haleellaa kanaan dura Raashiyaan raawwattee fi namoota ajjeeste booda, waldhabdeen biyyoota lamaanii hammaachaa dhufuu isaa kan agarsiisu dha.

title: Journalists locked out of the White House after Trump ban
english: Donald Trump has prohibited reporters from CNN, MSNBC, and Politico from entering the White House. These news organizations argue that the ban violates constitutional rights regarding freedom of the press. They believe the decision was made to punish them for their specific reporting on the administration.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የሲ ኤን ኤን፣ የኤም ኤስ ኤን ቢ ሲ እና የፖሊቲኮ ጋዜጠኞች ወደ ዋይት ሀውስ እንዳይገቡ ከልክለዋል። እነዚህ የዜና ተቋማት ክልከላው የፕሬስ ነፃነትን የሚጥስና ህገ-መንግስታዊ መብታቸውን የሚጋፋ ነው ሲሉ ይከራከራሉ። ውሳኔውም የተወሰደው በሪፖርታቸው ምክንያት በመሆኑ አድልዎ የተሞላበት መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Donald Traamp gabaasotni CNN, MSNBC fi Politico gara mana mootummaa (White House) akka hin seenne dhorkeera. Dhaabbileen oduu kun tarkaanfiin kun mirga bilisummaa miidiyaa fi heera mootummaa kan cabsu akka ta'e dubbatu. Akka isaan jedhanitti, dhorkaan kun gabaasa isaan mootummaa irratti dhiyeessaniin walqabatee kan fudhatamee dha.

title: Two German states go to the polls after far-right gains
english: Voters in Berlin and Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania are heading to the polls amid significant political uncertainty for Chancellor Friedrich Merz. His leadership faces pressure following a recent defeat by the far-right AfD party and low public approval ratings regarding his reform efforts. These regional elections are seen as a critical test for his coalition government and his future as head of the Christian Democratic Union.
amharic: የጀርመን ዋና ከተማ በርሊን እና ሜክለንበርግ-ዌስተርን ፖሜራኒያ ነዋሪዎች በቻንስለር ፍሬድሪክ ሜርዝ የፖለቲካ የወደፊት ዕጣ ፈንታ ላይ ተጽዕኖ ሊያሳርፍ በሚችል ምርጫ ላይ ድምጽ እየሰጡ ነው። የቻንስለሩ ፓርቲ በቅርቡ በከፍተኛ የቀኝ አክራሪ ቡድን ከተሸነፈ በኋላ እና በኢኮኖሚ ማሻሻያ እቅዶቹ ላይ የህዝብ ድጋፍ በመቀነሱ ከፍተኛ ጫና ውስጥ ይገኛል። እነዚህ ክልላዊ ምርጫዎች የሜርዝን የመሪነት ብቃት እና የጥምር መንግስታቸውን ጥንካሬ የሚፈትኑ ወሳኝ ክንውኖች ናቸው።
oromo: Filattoon mootummoota naannoo Berlin fi Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiru, dhiibbaa siyaasaa cimaa Chaanselar Firedirih Merz irratti uumuu danda'a. Paartiin Chaanselarichaa kanaan dura garee mirga-durtuu AfD irraa injifatamuun isaa fi jijjiirama dinagdee irratti deggersi uummataa xiqqaachuun isaa mootummaa isaa qormaata keessa galcheera. Filattoon kun hoggansa Merz fi cimina mootummaa isaanii irratti qormaata guddaa ta'ee jira.

title: Jammertest: Arctic exercise to counter satellite jamming
english: Military and technology firms are currently conducting annual drills in Norway known as Jammertest. These exercises focus on developing strategies to protect satellite communications from intentional signal interference. Such jamming poses a significant risk to critical infrastructure, including global transportation networks and financial systems.
amharic: የወታደራዊ እና የቴክኖሎጂ ኩባንያዎች በኖርዌይ ውስጥ 'ጃመርተስት' በመባል የሚታወቀውን አመታዊ ልምምድ እያካሄዱ ይገኛሉ። እነዚህ ልምምዶች የሳተላይት ምልክቶችን ሆን ተብሎ ከመስተጓጎል ለመከላከል የሚያስችሉ ስልቶችን ለማዘጋጀት ያለመ ነው። እንዲህ ዓይነቱ ጣልቃ ገብነት በአውሮፕላኖች፣ በመርከቦች እና በፋይናንስ ገበያዎች ላይ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ይደቅናል።
oromo: Dhaabbileen waraanaa fi teeknoolojii biyyoota addunyaa, biyya Noorweey keessatti 'Jammertest' kan jedhamuun beekamu shaakala waggaa gaggeessaa jiru. Shaakalichi mallattoowwan saateellayitii goobuu fi miidhuu irraa ittisuuf xiyyeeffata. Akkaataa kanaan mallattoowwan saateellayitii wal-qabsiisuun, akka xiyyaaraa fi doonii, akkasumas gabaa faayinaansii irratti miidhaa geessisuu danda'a.

title: State funeral honours Hong Kong’s first post-colonial leader Tung Chee-hwa
english: Hong Kong held a rare state funeral for Tung Chee-hwa, the city's inaugural leader after the 1997 transition from British rule. The ceremony, attended by high-ranking officials from both Hong Kong and Beijing, honored the former shipping tycoon who passed away at 89. Tung led the region through significant challenges like the Asian financial crisis and the SARS outbreak before stepping down from his post in 2005.
amharic: ሆንግ ኮንግ ከብሪታንያ አስተዳደር በኋላ የመጀመሪያው መሪ ለነበሩት ለቱንግ ቺ-ህዋ ብርቅዬ የሆነ የመንግስት የቀብር ስነስርዓት አከናውናለች። በ89 ዓመታቸው ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት የተለዩት የቀድሞው የባህር ትራንስፖርት ባለሀብት የቀብር ስነስርዓት፣ ከሆንግ ኮንግ እና ቤጂንግ በተውጣጡ ከፍተኛ ባለስልጣናት ተገኝተዋል። ቱንግ በስልጣን ዘመናቸው እንደ እስያ የፋይናንስ ቀውስ እና የሳርስ ወረርሽኝ ያሉ ትላልቅ ፈተናዎችን በማለፍ በ2005 ስልጣናቸውን በገዛ ፈቃዳቸው መልቀቃቸው ይታወሳል።
oromo: Hong Kong geggeessaa ishee jalqabaa erga bittaa Biritishii booda turan Tung Chii-hwaaf sirna awwaalcha mootummaa kabaja qabu raawwatteetti. Umuriin isaanii waggaa 89tti kan boqotan, qabeenyaa fi daldalaan kan beekaman Tung, sirna awwaalcha isaanii irratti hoggantoonni olaanoo Hong Kong fi Beijing argamaniiru. Tung yeroo hojii isaanii keessatti rakkoolee cimaa akka kutaaleen ardii Eeshiyaa diinagdee isaanii miidhamuu fi dhibee SARS wajjin walqabatu akkasumas bara 2005 aangoo gadhiisuu isaanii dura hojiiwwan gurguddoo hojjechaa turan.

title: Tunisian protesters demand release of four Sumud activists
english: Protesters in Tunis marched to demand the immediate release of four activists from the Global Sumud Flotilla who have been detained since March on financial charges. The activists are currently on a hunger strike to protest their imprisonment, and supporters are expressing deep concern as their physical health continues to worsen. Demonstrators claim the government's legal actions against these individuals are politically motivated and represent an effort to suppress civil society.
amharic: በቱኒዚያ ዋና ከተማ ታוניስ የሚገኙ ተቃዋሚዎች ከሰባት ወራት በፊት በፋይናንሺያል ክስ የታሰሩ የአራት የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች በአስቸኳይ እንዲለቀቁ ጠይቀዋል። እስረኞቹ በእስር ቤቱ የሚደርስባቸውን በደል በመቃወም የስራ ማቆም አድማ እያደረጉ ሲሆን የጤንነት ሁኔታቸውም አሳሳቢ ደረጃ ላይ ደርሷል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ እነዚህን ሰዎች ማሰር መንግስት የተቃውሞ ድምጾችን ለማፈን የሚጠቀምበት ስልት እንደሆነ ይገልጻሉ።
oromo: Mormitootni magaalaa Tunis keessatti argaman, aktivistoota garee 'Global Sumud Flotilla' kan ji'a Bitootessaa irraa eegalee himannaa faayinaansii irratti banamee hidhamanii jiran afur akka gadhiifaman gaafachaa jiru. Aktivistootni kunneen hidhamuu isaanii mormuun waggaa tokkoof nyaata dhaabuun erga eegalanii booda fayyaan isaanii baay'ee gad ta'uun isaa sodaa guddaa uumeera. Namootni hiriira ba'an kunneen, hidhaan kun yaada mormituu fi siviilii hawaasaa ukkaamsuuf kan karoorfamee ta'uu isaa dubbatu.

title: Two Palestinian men injured in West Bank settler attack
english: Two Palestinian men were wounded during an assault by Israeli settlers near the West Bank town of Salfit on Sunday. One victim suffered a head injury from a thrown rock, while the other was stabbed in the leg. Medical teams provided emergency care before transporting both individuals to a local hospital for further treatment.
amharic: እሁድ ዕለት በምዕራብ ባንክ ሳልፊት ከተማ አቅራቢያ በእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች በተፈጸመ ጥቃት ሁለት ፍልስጤማውያን ቆስለዋል። አንደኛው ግለሰብ በድንጋይ በመመታቱ የጭንቅላት ጉዳት የደረሰበት ሲሆን ሁለተኛው ደግሞ በጭኑ በቢላ ተወግቷል። የፍልስጤም ቀይ ጨረቃ አምቡላንስ ቡድን ለተጎጂዎቹ የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ህክምና ካደረገላቸው በኋላ ወደ ሆስፒታል ወስዷቸዋል።
oromo: Dilbata darbe naannoo magaalaa Salfiititti namoonni Falasxiin lama haleellaa warra Israa'el qe'ee qabatan irra gaheen miidhamaniiru. Namoota kanneen keessaa tokko dhagaan mataa isaa rukutamee miidhameera, inni biraan immoo gadii irra waraaneera. Gareen gargaarsa hatattamaa Falasxiin miidhamtoota kana yaalii jalqabaa taasifanii gara hospitaalaatti geessaniiru.

title: Trump cuts short weekend at Camp David, returns to White House
english: President Donald Trump unexpectedly returned to the White House from Camp David a day earlier than planned this weekend. While the administration did not provide an official reason, the move coincides with heightened tensions in the Middle East following a missile attack on Riyadh by Houthi rebels. Officials have also issued security warnings to U.S. citizens abroad regarding the potential for further regional instability.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከታቀደው ጊዜ ቀድመው ከካምፕ ዴቪድ በድንገት ወደ ዋይት ሀውስ ተመልሰዋል። መንግስት ለዚህ ውሳኔ ኦፊሴላዊ ምክንያት ባይሰጥም፣ ይህ ክስተት የሁቲ አማፂያን በሪያድ ላይ ሚሳይል ጥቃት ማድረሳቸውን ተከትሎ በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ በተፈጠረው ውጥረት ወቅት የተከሰተ ነው። በተጨማሪም፣ በአካባቢው ሊከሰት የሚችለውን አለመረጋጋት በመስጋት ለአሜሪካውያን የደህንነት ማስጠንቀቂያዎች ተላልፈዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Donald Traamp karoorfamee ture irra guyyaa tokko dursanii lafa boqonnaa isaanii Kaamp Deevidii irraa gara mana mootummaa (White House) deebi'aniiru. Mootummaan sababa isaa ifatti baasee hin ibsine; ta'us, tarkaanfiin kun kan dhufe erga gareen Huutii Riyaaditti xiyyaara waraanaa ergee booda naannicha keessatti jeequmsi dabaluu isaa wajjin wal qabata. Kana malees, lammiileen Ameerikaa naannicha jiran akka of eeggannoo godhan akeekkachiisni tasgabbii dabarfameera.

title: West Bank families led by women face greater displacement risks, OCHA says
english: A UN report indicates that households led by women in the West Bank are at a higher risk of displacement due to increasing violence from Israeli settlers. These families also struggle more with chronic health issues and face significant obstacles in travel and employment due to movement restrictions. Despite these challenges, these women continue to carry the primary responsibility for managing finances, childcare, and their families' overall safety.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት እንደገለጸው በዌስት ባንክ በሴቶች የሚመሩ ቤተሰቦች በእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች ጥቃት ምክንያት ለከፍተኛ መፈናቀል ተጋልጠዋል። እነዚህ ቤተሰቦች ከጤና ችግሮች በተጨማሪ የመንቀሳቀስ ገደቦች በመኖራቸው የኑሮ ሁኔታቸውን ለማሟላት ይቸገራሉ። ከዚህ ሁሉ ችግር ጎን ለጎን እነዚህ ሴቶች የቤተሰባቸውን የገቢ ምንጭ፣ የልጆች እንክብካቤ እና ደህንነትን በዋናነት የመምራት ኃላፊነት ወስደዋል።
oromo: Gabaasni dhaabbata mootummoota gamtoomanii akka ibsutti, maatiiwwan naannoo West Bank keessa jiraatan kan dubartoonni hoogganan, haleellaa qonnaan bultoota Israa'el irraa ga'uun buqqa'uuf saaxilamoo dha. Maatiiwwan kun rakkoolee fayyaa fi daangaa sochiin walqabatuun jireenya isaanii jiraachuuf baay'ee rakkatu. Rakkoo kana hunda keessa illee, dubartoonni kun itti gaafatamummaa maatii bulchuu, ijoollee guddifachuu fi nageenya maatii isaanii eeguu qofa isaanii baachaa jiru.

title: Israeli strikes target Lebanon's Nabatieh, ambulance team
english: Israeli military aircraft conducted multiple airstrikes across southern Lebanon, specifically targeting the city of Nabatieh and the Bint Jbeil district. During the operation, an ambulance crew providing emergency aid was also struck. These attacks resulted in significant property damage, including the destruction of a residential building.
amharic: የእስራኤል የጦር አውሮፕላኖች በደቡብ ሊባኖስ ናባቲህ ከተማ እና በቢንት ዝቤይል አውራጃ ላይ ተከታታይ የአየር ጥቃቶችን ፈጽመዋል። በጥቃቱ ወቅት የሕክምና እርዳታ ለመስጠት በአካባቢው የነበረ የአምቡላንስ ቡድንም ኢላማ ሆኗል። ጥቃቱ የመኖሪያ ቤት መውደምን ጨምሮ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት አስከትሏል።
oromo: Xiyyaaroonni waraana Israaʼel kibba Libaanoos, keessattuu magaalaa Nabatiyeh fi naannoo Bint Jbeil irratti haleellaa qilleensa irraa raawwataniiru. Haleellaa kana gidduutti, gargaarsa hatattamaa kennuuf kan turan gareen ambuulaansii tokkos haleelamaniiru. Haleellaan kun mana jireenyaa diigamuu dabalatee miidhaa guddaa geessiseera.

title: WEGAGEN SWELLS BALANCE SHEET, PROMISES
english: The Ethiopian Parliament has officially approved a new cabinet consisting of 22 ministers. Notably, this appointment includes three leaders from opposition parties. While the motion passed successfully, two members of parliament voted against it and 12 chose to abstain.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ፓርላማ አዲስ የተሾሙ 22 ሚኒስትሮችን በይፋ አጽድቋል። በዚህ የሹመት ዝርዝር ውስጥ ከሶስት የተቃዋሚ ፓርቲ አመራሮች የተውጣጡ አባላት መካተታቸው ታውቋል። አዲሱ የካቢኔ አወቃቀር በፓርላማው ቢጸድቅም፣ ሁለት አባላት ተቃውሞ የገጠሙ ሲሆን 12ቱ ደግሞ ድምጸ ተዓቅቦ አድርገዋል።
oromo: Parlamaan Itoophiyaa ministiroota haaraa 22 ta'an ifatti raggaasee jira. Muudama kana keessatti hogganoonni paartilee mormituu sadii ta'an kan hammataman yoo ta'u, kunis jijjiirama siyaasaa iddoo guddaa qabuudha. Murtichi yoo raggaasifameyyuu, miseensonni mana marichaa lama mormii isaanii ibsatanii, 12 immoo sagalee kennuu irraa of qusataniiru.

title: The Leather Trade Rots Be-tween Slaughter, Factory
english: Despite Ethiopia possessing one of the largest cattle populations in the world, its leather industry is currently declining. A significant amount of potential value is wasted because hides and skins often spoil during the transition from slaughterhouses to processing factories. This inefficiency negatively impacts the livelihoods of collectors and limits the overall success of the leather sector.
amharic: ኢትዮጵያ ከሚሊዮን በላይ የከብቶች ሀብት ቢኖራትም የቆዳና ሌጦ ኢንዱስትሪዋ ግን እያሽቆለቆለ ይገኛል። ከእርድ ቦታዎች ወደ ፋብሪካዎች በሚደረግ የትራንስፖርት እና አያያዝ ሂደት ውስጥ ከፍተኛ መጠን ያለው የቆዳ ምርት በመበላሸቱ ሀገሪቱ ተጠቃሚ መሆን አልቻለችም። ይህ የዘርፉ ድክመት በቆዳ ሰብሳቢዎች ኑሮ ላይ አሉታዊ ተጽዕኖ እያሳደረ ይገኛል።
oromo: Itoophiyaan qabeenya loonii baay'ee kan qabdu ta'us, industiriin gogaa biyyattii amma gadi bu'aa jira. Gogaan qulqulluun qaleettii irraa gara maashinota gogaa qopheessaniitti yeroo geeffamu balali'uun gatii isaa dhabuun isaa industiricha miidheera. Rakkoon kun jireenya namoota gogaa sassaabanii irratti dhiibbaa geessisaa jira.

title: Grid Power Reaches Kurmuk Goldmine as Allied Gold Regroups
english: The Canadian mining firm Allied Gold has successfully linked its Kurmuk gold project in Ethiopia to the national power grid. By utilizing an 88-kilometer transmission line, the company has started processing ore at the site. This development brings the project close to producing its first gold, though commercial operations have not yet officially commenced.
amharic: የካናዳው የማዕድን ኩባንያ አላይድ ጎልድ በኢትዮጵያ የሚገኘውን የኩርሙክ ወርቅ ማዕድን ማውጫ ከሀገራዊ የኤሌክትሪክ ኃይል መረብ ጋር ማገናኘቱን አስታውቋል። ኩባንያው በ88 ኪሎ ሜትር የኤሌክትሪክ መስመር አማካኝነት ማዕድኑን መፍጨት የጀመረ ሲሆን፣ ይህም ለወርቅ ምርት ዝግጅቱ ትልቅ እርምጃ ሆኗል። ምንም እንኳን የመጀመሪያው የወርቅ ምርት በቅርቡ እንደሚጠበቅ ቢገለጽም፣ ኩባንያው እስካሁን የንግድ ምርት መጀመሩን አላረጋገጠም።
oromo: Dhaabbanni qonna albuudaa kan Kaanaadaa, Allied Gold, pirojektii warqee Kurmuk kan Itoophiyaa keessa jiru gara marsaarii elektirikii biyyoolessaatti milkaa'inaan goggooseera. Sarsara elektirikii kiilomeetira 88 dheeratu fayyadamuun, dhaabbattichi albuuda naquu fi daakudhaan hojii eegaleera. Kunis pirojektichi warqee jalqabaa akka argatu gargaara, ta'us hojiin gurgurtaa inni gurguddaan ammatti hin eegalle.

title: Central Bank Bars Banks from Paying Deposit Interest Up-front
english: The National Bank of Ethiopia has issued an immediate ban on banks paying interest on deposits before the agreed-upon maturity period ends. This directive prevents financial institutions from crediting interest upfront or adding it to the principal balance prematurely. The move follows regulatory findings that some banks were improperly advancing interest payments before the required holding time was met.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ብሔራዊ ባንክ የባንክ ተቀማጭ ገንዘብ ወለድ በስምምነት ከተቀመጠበት ጊዜ በፊት መከፈልን በይፋ አግዷል። ይህ ትዕዛዝ ባንኮች ወለድን ከጊዜው ቀድመው እንዲከፍሉ ወይም ወደ ዋናው ሂሳብ እንዲጨምሩ ይከለክላል። የቁጥጥር ምርመራዎች አንዳንድ ባንኮች የጊዜ ገደቡ ሳይሞላ ወለድን አስቀድመው ሲከፍሉ በመገኘታቸው ይህ እርምጃ እንዲወሰድ ተደርጓል።
